notes.title: New Update to Misao - 2024 HD Remaster Coming Midnight August 15, 2024!
notes.content:
Misao: Definitive Edition was released back in October 2017, and now it's about to be updated to Misao - 2024 HD Remaster at midnight on August 15, 2024!

Misao - 2024 HD Remaster doesn't only add HD graphics and update the overall presentation, but also adds new features that make exploring stages all the more enjoyable, giving the game a new playfeel.

No matter if you've already witnessed all the horrors of Misao, or are stepping into the Other World for the first time, we hope you enjoy the newly reborn Misao.

The original Misao: Definitive Edition can still be played after the update. You may choose which version to play upon launch.

After the HD Remaster update, the price of the game will be increased to $9.99. However, the game is currently on sale for 20% off its original price until 9:59 AM August 14, so please grab this chance to buy the game before the price increase!

notes.title: Update Announcement (Ver 1.04)
notes.content:
Thank you for playing Misao: Definitive Edition.
The updates for Ver 1.04 are as follows:

[list]
[*]Option settings will now preserve changes even after closing and reopening the game. 
This change also means that all changes made to option settings will be shared among different save files.
(All settings on all save files will be reset to default upon first launch after installing this update)

[*]Minor bug fixes.
[/list]
Thank you, and enjoy Misao: Definitive Edition!

(Japanese Only)
College dropout Mae Borowski returns home to the crumbling former mining town of Possum Springs seeking to resume her aimless former life and reconnect with the friends she left behind. But things aren't the same. Home seems different now and her friends have grown and changed. Leaves are falling and the wind is growing colder. Strange things are happening as the light fades.
Coming soon to PC (JP), Nintendo Switch (JP), PlayStation 4 (JP), Xbox One (JP)
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 9 Indie Game Corner 9-B43[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/481510/Night_in_the_Woods/

Climb into the cockpit of an otherworldly war machine and fly into battle against a horrifying alien race bent on eradicating humanity to preserve their own civilization.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch.

Wielding magic blades, four girls fight back successive waves of monsters in this exhilarating hack-and-slash action game!
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch. 


[h1]Will -A Wonderful World-[/h1]
(Japanese Only)
A young girl wakes up, groggy in an unknown room. A talking dog appears before her and she becomes startled by the revelation he tells her: They are gods and it is their duty to change the fate of any humans that ask for their help. Letters appear in the mail and with pen in hand she begins her job.
Coming soon to Nintendo Switch (JP) and PlayStation 4 (JP)
https://store.steampowered.com/app/588040/WILL_A_Wonderful_World__WILL/


[h1]La-Mulana 2 OST[/h1]
The Original Soundtrack for La-Mulana 2 has now been released! Relive the ruins with 59 tracks! 
[b]Currently on show at TGS @ Hall 5, Konami Booth[/b]

notes.title: Misao: Definitive Edition Out Now!
notes.content:
We have just released Misao: Definitive Edition on Steam!
[quote][i]Just three months ago, a young girl went missing. Her name is Misao. She was a classmate of the player's character.
Quiet and reclusive, this plain girl was often the target of bullies.
Since the day she disappeared, rumors spread throughout the school of unnatural phenomena. 
The children called it "Misao's curse"...[/i][/quote]
http://store.steampowered.com/app/691450/Misao_Definitive_Edition/

[h1]Comment from Sen (developer)[/h1]
[i]I created Misao as a project to learn how to develop games, but I put a lot of work into it and had been meaning to give it a remake for a long time.
For the remake, the graphics and the puzzle system have been vamped up.
I hope people who played the original version would enjoy playing this new definitive edition of Misao too! [/i]


[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30950918/deedae79dea58f151bffb57ed827b9df6359af08.jpg[/img]

We have also made some updates on Mad Father, so check that out too: 
http://steamcommunity.com/games/483980/announcements/detail/1462967940427289682

http://store.steampowered.com/app/483980/Mad_Father/
